description: This file defines functions related to platform-specific firmware upgrade procedures for a specific device in the OpenWrt firmware system, including a default upgrade handler and a platform check.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Function that performs a check on the firmware image before upgrade, currently always returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Function that executes the firmware upgrade process, delegating to a default upgrade method based on board name.
